name: supabase-auth
title: Supabase Auth
description: Supabase email, password, and TOTP authentication module with session provider, route guards, sign-up, and authenticator enrollment screens.
docs: Wrap the application in QueryClientProvider and AuthProvider. Route /auth to <AuthPage appName="Your App" />, /auth/sign-up to <AuthPage appName="Your App" mode="sign-up" />, and nest authenticated routes under <ProtectedRoute />. Supabase must have TOTP multi-factor enabled, and StitchEmailGate restricts routes to @stitchstudio.ai accounts.
